in_marathi.name: Jaydeb
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Victory of God
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jaydeb हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jaydeb is a Sanskrit name derived from two words: 'Jaya' meaning victory and 'Dev' meaning God. This name signifies the victory of God over all obstacles in one's life.
